successCriteria.description: PgLeavePolicyRepository implements all 6 methods of ILeavePolicyRepository (findById, findByLeaveType, findAll, create, update, delete) with exact matching signatures — the TypeScript compiler verifies `implements ILeavePolicyRepository` without errors.
All SQL queries use parameterized placeholders ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation or template concatenation of user-supplied values into SQL text.

The barrel export at src/modules/leave-policy/index.ts re-exports exactly three public symbols: LeavePolicy (model), ILeavePolicyRepository (interface), and PgLeavePolicyRepository (class). No internal symbols leak.
The repository imports the shared pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other database connection, no inline pool creation, no direct pg.Client instantiation.
create() generates a unique id via crypto.randomUUID() and sets createdAt/updatedAt to the current timestamp; the returned LeavePolicy includes those server-assigned fields.

update() returns null when the target row does not exist (idempotent not-found), and handles nullable fields (accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays) correctly — a Partial<LeavePolicy> with undefined for a nullable field preserves the existing value rather than overwriting with null.
delete() returns a boolean: true when a row was deleted (rowCount > 0), false when no matching row existed.

constraints: The repository MUST import the pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other database connection source, no inline pool creation, no direct pg.Client instantiation.
All SQL MUST use parameterized queries ($1, $2, …). No string interpolation, template literals, or concatenation for query values.
The module MUST NOT import from any other domain module's internals. Allowed imports: src/shared/types/index.ts, src/shared/db/connection.ts, and the module's own files (model, repository interface).
outOfScope: Jest unit tests at tests/unit/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.repository.test.ts — the PLAN.md Phase 2 mentions them but this sub-phase task description only covers the repository implementation and barrel export files. Unit tests are deferred to a subsequent phase or a dedicated test phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every LeavePolicy row persisted by the repository MUST have a non-null, unique id (generated server-side via crypto.randomUUID()), non-null policyName, non-null leaveType (matching a LeaveType enum value), non-null entitlementDays (positive integer), non-null requiresManagerApproval, non-null isActive, and non-null createdAt/updatedAt timestamps. Nullable fields (accrualRate, maxAccumulation, minimumNoticeDays) may be null.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null when no row matches — never throws for a missing row.
Returns null when no policy exists for the given leaveType — never throws for a missing row.
Returns an empty array when no policies exist — never returns null.
Creates a new row with a server-generated id and timestamps. Returns the fully populated LeavePolicy. Fails only on database-level errors (e.g., constraint violation).
Returns null when the target row does not exist. When data contains undefined for a nullable field, the existing database value is preserved (not overwritten with null).
Returns true when a row was deleted, false when no matching row existed. Never throws for a missing row.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The PgLeavePolicyRepository class MUST implement the ILeavePolicyRepository interface exactly as declared — method names, parameter types, return types, and Promise wrappers must match without deviation.
The LeavePolicy model re-exported from the barrel MUST match the LeavePolicy interface declared in the model file — same fields, same types, same optionality.

The snake_case column names used in SQL queries (policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at) MUST match the leave_policies table schema as declared in the reconciled architecture.
The repository MUST use the singleton pool exported from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other pool, no direct pg.Pool construction, no separate connection management.

integrationPoints.why: The repository acquires database connections exclusively through the shared pool exported here.
